description: This file defines a React functional component 'SessionsByOrganization' that renders a responsive bar chart visualizing session counts grouped by organization name. It imports chart components from 'recharts', theme and color utilities, and handles loading, error, and empty data states.

methods.name: truncateLabel
methods.description: Truncates a label string to a maximum length, appending an ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A React component that renders a custom tooltip for the bar chart, showing the organization name and session count.
